sourceVerification.websiteFetch: Direct promptfoo.dev website fetches failed DNS resolution in this environment. Website documentation URLs below are reference links, not claims of successful website access.
sourceVerification.method: Documentation was read via GitHub raw upstream files using curl. Option names were cross-checked against the pinned 0.124.1 upstream TypeScript source and installed provider bundles. Exact generated configurations for all three profiles successfully loaded through the installed promptfoo loadApiProvider API.

cleanInstallVerification.result: Both commands exited zero in a fresh project copy excluding node_modules, .git, .eval-results, and .authoring-exercise. A separate project-local npm cache was used.
cleanInstallVerification.offlineTests: 17 passed, including dry-run contract tests for Codex, Claude, and Copilot.
cleanInstallVerification.liveResult: Passed with real SDK tool use and skill invocation after workspace read restrictions were applied.

promptfoo.execution: The worker loads the native provider through promptfoo and calls its SDK-backed callApi method. Grading happens independently in the parent process; expectations are not provider variables.

codex.verification: Generated provider loaded successfully. A real smoke attempt reached the native provider but exceeded the explicit 15000ms process timeout. No successful Codex task execution is claimed.
codex.observationLimits: Native raw turn items expose command_execution and file_change. Provider skill metadata is heuristic, so command-based skill reads require raw-trace inspection.

verifiedConfiguration: disallowed_tools: [Write, Edit, Bash, NotebookEdit, WebFetch, WebSearch]
claude.verification: Generated provider loaded successfully. A real smoke attempt failed because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was absent. No successful Claude task execution is claimed.
claude.observationLimits: Native metadata exposes skillCalls, toolCalls, and permissionDenials. Absent tool evidence does not prove that a skill was not activated.

entryPoints: client.createSession({ workingDirectory, configDirectory, enableConfigDiscovery: false, skillDirectories, availableTools, onPermissionRequest })
copilot.skillDiscovery: Explicit skillDirectories points to the isolated .agents/skills directory.
copilot.permissions: A read request provides request.kind === read and request.path. Only realpath-resolved workspace descendants receive { kind: approve-once }; all other requests receive { kind: reject, feedback }. The installed native runtime rejects approve and approved as callback responses; approve-once was verified in a successful live run.
copilot.verification: A real R1/current smoke passed after workspace read restrictions were applied. Native tool execution and skill.invoked for review-code were observed.
copilot.observationLimits: session.skills_loaded indicates discovery, not invocation. skill.invoked indicates invocation, not correct reasoning. Absence of observed write requests does not prove complete trace coverage.

dependencyAdvisories.directPackages: All four exact direct dependency versions were checked against the GitHub advisory tool before installation; it reported no vulnerabilities.
dependencyAdvisories.override: basic-ftp 6.2.3 was advisory-checked and pinned as an override.
dependencyAdvisories.remaining: npm audit reported three high-severity affected packages in the promptfoo -> jks-js -> node-forge path. Latest available node-forge 1.4.0 remained affected at verification time. No zero-vulnerability claim is made.
